system.description:
Toadclan are small, squat Curiot folk, who typically resemble humanoid toads or frogs. They are frequent fermenters and cheesemongers, and are known for their sense of taste.

Size: Medium (3.5–5 feet) · Lifespan: Typically 30–50 years

Abilities: @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.cultures.Item.0b0cd0b670ef32d1]{Toxic Skin}

Lore uses (from level 4): @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.abilities-lore.Item.0259e62272efc111]{Toxic Touch}

Olganyar ancestry. Curiot Heritage. Rulebook p.53.
